statement: Report's durable input snapshots hold sensitive upstream evidence with their own reproduction obligations (report#283 audit finding 4). This contract STATES the governing policy references, the reproduction availability a snapshot provides, and the interface to the responsible lifecycle authority. It deliberately implements NO retention automation: legal hold, purge, and document retention execution belong to lotus-archive for archived documents, and no second retention or legal-hold engine exists here. Snapshot rows are retained under the named policy until a governed deletion capability is specified and certified; deletion is currently not implemented, and that absence is stated rather than implied away.

policies.applies_to: report_input_snapshot rows and their append-only upstream-call lineage
policies.reproduction_statement: A successful capture supports recomposing the exact document semantics from the immutable snapshot and answering what the document presented without replaying current policy. The executable rerender command (POST /reports/jobs/{job_id}/rerender) is a separate lifecycle-dependent fact available only to archived PDF jobs - the snapshot capability never advertises a command the job has not earned. A failed capture records failure evidence only and supports no reproduction. Policy 1.0.0 stamped the value rerender_from_snapshot for this same capability; rows carrying it read as snapshot_recomposition and are never rewritten.
policies.retention_statement: Snapshots are retained at least as long as the archived documents they can reproduce or explain remain under lotus-archive retention. No automated deletion exists; a future governed deletion capability must resolve against lotus-archive document retention and legal holds BEFORE removing reproduction evidence.
policies.legal_hold_interface: lotus-archive owns legal hold for archived documents; a hold on a document implies its snapshot must not be deleted. Report enforces this trivially today because no snapshot deletion path exists.
policies.lifecycle_authority_interface: lotus-archive:documents for archived-document retention, hold, purge, and access audit; lotus-report:report_input_snapshot for snapshot custody under this policy
